title: IFLGoogleCalendarEventsListV1Request
description: Request body for ifl.google_calendar.events.list.v1 (K1 -> Google Calendar). Lists events on the caller's primary calendar between time_min and time_max.

account_id.description: Google account identifier; pairs with the per-account MCP child (mcp.multi_instance).

calendar_id.description: Calendar id; defaults to the account's primary calendar.

single_events.description: Whether to expand recurring events into single instances.
